svg.aria-label: Snowflake 64-bit ID layout: 1 sign bit (always 0), 41 bits of timestamp, 5 bits of datacenter ID, 5 bits of machine ID and 12 bits of sequence number. The example decodes to 503,308,025,343 ms after Twitter's epoch (2026-10-16 09:30:00 UTC), datacenter 3, machine 7, sequence 5, which together read as the ID 2111026863928668165.
svg.title: Snowflake ID layout
